mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing overcast skies at Fireman's Park with a temperature of 61 degrees. While the ISS will pass overhead tonight, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

In city news, please be advised that road maintenance through chip sealing starts on September 23, affecting areas like Cross Country Road and Liberty Business Park. Additionally, the Plan Commission is meeting on October 5 to review various development projects across the city.

There is plenty happening this weekend. Today you can enjoy the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival, live music at Bailey's Run, and Bike the Barns at Badger Prairie County Park. Looking ahead, you can catch yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow or trivia nights on Tuesday at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's.

In our weekly police report, on September 10, officers responded to a burglary in progress on Hunters Cove Way where a suspect was apprehended after a shooting incident occurred. Thankfully, officers were on scene to handle the situation quickly.
Regarding Culver's of Verona, the restaurant is currently closed for a remodel, so please plan your dining accordingly.
